learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain knowledge about the application of computers in the design process.
Students will learn methods for geometrical modeling of parts or assemblies.
Students will understand general questions connected to the creation of CAD systems.

syllabus_topics: General information about the design of technical objects
Mathematical modeling in computer aided design
Drawing Creation of parts and assemblies
Architecture and general principles of the CAD system creation

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (two theoretical questions and one part modeling task)

assessment_rules: At the exam students answer two theoretical questions and solve one task, connected with the part modeling. A discussion with the student can be carried out for the formation of the final mark.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
